notes.title: Small Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the character could "slip" a little when walking over rubble
 Highlight effect improved for distant items

notes.title: A major update is on the horizon
notes.notes:
In the last few months, The Trud has been going through a rework, I made that decision after seeing that some players didn't have the experience they expected with the game. So I took some time to rethink and redesign various aspects of the game based on your feedback to deliver the best possible experience for new and old players. This update among other things will bring


 Bug fixes
 New Mechanics
 New controls
 A new way for telling the story
 New monsters and paranormal events


The update doesn't have a release date yet, but the good news is that it shouldn't take too long, stay tuned to the game's steam community page for more information.
